einzeiler: A mother faces an impossible choice after her fiancé is accused of child abuse.
kurzfassung: Days after her engagement, Cindy discovers her fiancé has been accused of abusing one of her children. Doubting the facts, she faces a devastating dilemma that tears her family apart. She must decide whether to support her child or what she believes is the truth.
stichpunkte: Cindy learns of child abuse accusations against her fiancé Kenny five days after her engagement
The initial facts behind the allegation did not make sense to Cindy
The allegation causes severe division within the family
Cindy faces the choice between standing by her child or standing by her belief in the truth
beschreibung:
Just five days after her engagement to Kenny, Cindy learns that her fiancé was accused of abusing one of Cindy’s children. The facts behind the accusation didn’t add up to Cindy. As the allegation tore her family apart, Cindy faced an impossible choice: stand by her child or stand by what she believed to be the truth. New episodes of Burden of Guilt drop every Wednesday.

You can reach out to the Burden of Guilt team at Burdenofguiltpod@gmail.com. For more Burden of Guilt, follow us on Instagram @glasspodcasts.
